consequential_claims.claim: Issue #8901 reports rendered but unselectable rectangle with reordered axes, scale 0.01, translation 5.1, napari 0.7.0.
consequential_claims.reason: Original report matches the proposed conditions. A report is correctly separated from independent reproduction.

consequential_claims.claim: PR #9394 links that issue and explains drawing/picking disagreement for fractional real-valued slice keys.
consequential_claims.reason: Code and PR agree: planar dimensions use strict half-slice tolerance; spanning dimensions retain interval containment. This is not a general affine-transform proof.

consequential_claims.claim: Three named regression tests exist and cover fractional picking/render agreement and unwidened spanning boundaries.
consequential_claims.reason: Inspected tests at exact merge commit. Upstream test execution statement is attributed to PR author, not claimed as candidate execution.

consequential_claims.claim: Fix merged 2 October after v0.9.2 published 29 September; released source lacks this fix; 0.10.0 milestone is open.
consequential_claims.reason: Actual merge SHA/date and release date corroborated. Released predicate is the old exact-containment form. Open milestone supports caution; no whole-application guarantee inferred.

consequential_claims.claim: The trace supports a common mapping and common boundary tests for rendering/picking/persistence/export, while proving only specific Shapes behavior.
consequential_claims.reason: Useful engineering inference against the brief, with explicit extrapolation limit. Persistence/export validation remains proposed.

consequential_claims.claim: Tifffile 2026.9.20 documents TIFF-backed Zarr region selection and compressed-codec dependency.
consequential_claims.reason: Exact tagged README gives return_as=zarr, read-only zarr.open and region example; codec dependency exists. Candidate explicitly withholds universal bounded-memory performance claim.

consequential_claims.claim: Zarr 3.4.0 documents loading requested slice regions into NumPy rather than claiming full-application memory guarantees.
consequential_claims.reason: Versioned guide supports component-level region access. Runtime laziness, cache/cancellation and 3 GB peak memory remain explicit adoption tests.

consequential_claims.claim: NGFF 0.5.2/0.5 defines axis metadata, scale/translation, multiscales, integer labels and Zarr v3.
consequential_claims.reason: Pinned specification supports these selected facts. Dataset transforms allow scale plus optional subsequent translation, not arbitrary orientation. Label samples are integers. This is not proof of interoperability of unbuilt app exports.

consequential_claims.claim: NGFF omero display metadata is transitional and should not control app provenance.
consequential_claims.reason: Transitional status is explicit in spec; non-authoritative app manifest is a product choice, not a claim imposed by NGFF.

consequential_claims.claim: Napari, tifffile and Zarr are independently useful implementation precedents at viewer/parser/array layers.
consequential_claims.reason: Separate repositories/code responsibilities contribute different useful mechanisms. This establishes useful layer independence, not source-isolation history or integrated compatibility.

consequential_claims.claim: First-stack package versions and merge commit exist; they are prototype pins, not a tested combined lockfile.
consequential_claims.reason: Selected identities verified. Candidate correctly makes shipping conditional on tagged fix plus own coordinate checks. Joint integration/install feasibility is UNASSESSED.

consequential_claims.claim: A 256x256 uint16 plane is 128 KiB; 512 MiB holds 4096 such tiles before overhead.
consequential_claims.reason: Independent arithmetic: 256*256*2=131072 bytes; 512*1024*1024/131072=4096. Numerical illustration only, not measured cache capacity.

consequential_claims.claim: Source identity, named axes, index-to-physical mapping, read-only originals, derived-asset provenance and explicit relocation are proposed contracts.
consequential_claims.reason: Clearly marked engineering inference/product choices fit the actual brief and avoid unsupported performance promises. Full project architecture, concurrency/fsync/recovery/export correctness are outside this targeted diagnostic assessment.

consequential_claims.claim: Candidate executed W01 arithmetic and an earlier failed scratch attempt; details are in witnesses.json.
consequential_claims.reason: No witness catalog, code/input, receipt, stdout/stderr/exit or expectation evidence was supplied in Phase 1. This neither proves execution nor establishes a false execution claim.
